note: Combined city and county rates per $100 of assessed value, using the latest rates found for each area (2026 for Williamson and Rutherford counties; 2025 for Davidson and Maury counties). Tennessee assesses residential property at 25% of its appraised value. Rates change each year; update this file when new rates are published.
